text:
maya: Quick thread to lock the Heliotrope Systems customer story. Need: interview, hero + long quote, legal sign-off on perf numbers, gated benchmark PDF, and a webinar the week after publish. Target publish: Thu next week. Can we land this by Tue EOD?

rene: I can run the interview Tue 10am PT. Will ask about deployment, perf wins, and rollout blockers.

pat: I'll draft two quote options. Messaging should lead with predictable latency + cost per inference drop.

alex: Sales request: add post-publish routing rule to send MQLs to enterprise-inbound@ and AE-oncall.

tara: Ops exported perf CSV: /mnt/bench/heliotrope/heliotrope-2026-05-redacted.csv. I'll prepare a sanitized snapshot for the gated PDF.

legal-bot: Reminder: do not publish contract amounts or raw customer revenue. Replace absolute counts ("millions") with "large-scale production users" unless customer confirms. Upload NDA/consent links here.

maya: Interview brief (short):
```
Interviewer: Rene
Length: 25 min
Goals: problem, model & infra, top 2 impact metrics, hero soundbite
Sample perf command (sanitized):
./run_bench --model open-7b --seq 1024 --batch 8 --samples 1000 > out.json
```

pat: Hero quote candidate: "Redwood made inference predictable at scale for us." Long quote: "Switching to Redwood's routing and prefix caching cut our median latency by ~60% and reduced per-inference cost, unlocking a realtime feature roll-out."

alex: Confirming webinar format: 30-min demo + 15-min Q&A. Tara can set registration and promo once hero quote is approved.

ops: Pub slot tentatively reserved: 2026-05-14 09:00 PT. Pending legal sign-off and final copy.

legal-bot: I'll review quotes and the appendix after interview transcript and benchmark CSV are uploaded. Expect sign-off within 48 hours.

maya: Great. Checklist: interview scheduled, consent uploaded, hero+long quotes captured, legal review, gated PDF, post-publish routing test, webinar page live. Checkpoint Tue EOD.

end of thread
